items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Gene Krupa's out there at the Sherman and we're in the La Salle

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. In there we did everything. As I say, we went in there, we went to the bar. People started asking us to sit at the tables, and so Smith couldn't say no because these are the big customers, and they're going to say what is this, they can't sit over here, you know. Can't sit at a table? We'd like to talk to him, you know. And then Stuff was hanging out all day and bought him a tear gas gun. He comes in at night and our dressing room's right off the kitchen, and he goes out in the kitchen, and the waiters…

there was any way I could get you all out of here," he said, "You wouldn't spend another day in here." But he said, "You've been doing such great business. The place has been packed every night." He says, "I don't understand it, you guys do everything in here." I said, "Don't say you guys. Tell it to Stuff." He said, "I can't talk to him. He always runs by me all the time, you know." So now, to set it off good, now Petrillo's a tough man out there, so Petrillo's got a thing somebody's supposed to be elected…

to do that?" I said, "Petrillo said do it." He said, "Well, you better go ahead and do it then, if he told you." He said, "You'd better do it, then," you know. After it happened the man must have wanted something but he come in there one night and about 10:00 o'clock and we wasn't supposed to get off till 1:00, and he come in there about 10:00 o'clock and said, "You all come up in Room 1432, I'm having a little party up there."
